{"join":" LEFT JOIN {prefix}term_relationships ON ({prefix}posts.ID = {prefix}term_relationships.object_id)","where":" AND ( 
  {prefix}term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id IN ({term}) 
  OR 
  ( 
    EXISTS (
					SELECT {term}
					FROM {prefix}term_relationships
					INNER JOIN {prefix}term_taxonomy
					ON {prefix}term_taxonomy.term_taxonomy_id = {prefix}term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id
					WHERE {prefix}term_taxonomy.taxonomy = 'post_tag'
					AND {prefix}term_relationships.object_id = {prefix}posts.ID
				) 
    AND 
    {prefix}posts.ID NOT IN (
				SELECT object_id
				FROM {prefix}term_relationships
				WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN ({term})
			)
  ) 
  OR 
  (
				SELECT COUNT({term})
				FROM {prefix}term_relationships
				WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN ({term})
				AND object_id = {prefix}posts.ID
			) = {term} 
  OR 
  NOT EXISTS (
					SELECT {term}
					FROM {prefix}term_relationships
					INNER JOIN {prefix}term_taxonomy
					ON {prefix}term_taxonomy.term_taxonomy_id = {prefix}term_relationships.term_taxonomy_id
					WHERE {prefix}term_taxonomy.taxonomy = 'post_format'
					AND {prefix}term_relationships.object_id = {prefix}posts.ID
				)
)"}
